“哎呀，傻子，你往哪吸呢，你，你！”
柳雪怡难为情死了，但是又不敢动，想着这傻子是想把蛇毒吸出来吧，是在救自己，也就不敢乱动了。
“妈，你忍忍吧，命要紧了。”杨紫安抚着。
柳大春双手抱着柳雪怡，努力把蛇毒吸出来，不然蛇毒入血循环是很麻烦的事。
柳大春没怎么接触过女人，这一刻，柳大春如此亲密碰触，更是让他内心的某种欲望大发。
体内的锦鳞蚺更是蠢蠢欲动，有一种让柳大春暗黑和着魔的冲动。
柳雪怡急着问，好在这附近没村民，不至于那么尴尬，要是被人看见，可就要丢脸死了。
柳大春吸蛇毒吸了好久，才吸了出来。
“婶婶，应该好了。”柳大春解释道。
“真的吗？我不会死了吗？”柳雪怡还是很担忧。
“不会，竹叶青不是剧毒蛇呢。”柳大春解释着。
“哦。”柳雪怡急忙整理了一下自己，红了脸，难为情死了。
这时，柳雪怡才发现，柳大春死死盯着自己看。
“傻子，谢谢你啊，没事了就好。你个傻子，还真的抓到蛇了啊。”
柳雪怡还是挺惊讶的，这个傻子，看起来比之前精明了许多。
“嗯，妈，那我们先回去吧，观察观察，有问题，咱们马上去医院。”杨紫说道。
“婶婶，你去采点溪黄草来，马上回去熬着喝了，可以帮助肝脏把剩余的蛇毒排出来，回去要多喝水，通过尿液排出来。”柳大春又加上了一句。
“傻子，我也不认识溪黄草啊？”柳雪怡说道。

“这样我等下去采点给你们送过去，或者去村医老吴那问问。”柳大春说道。
“那行，那我们走了。”柳雪怡婶婶说道。
“等等，婶婶你是给我看了，可是杨紫她。”柳大春可没忘记了杨紫下的赌注呢。
“我怎么了？我又没被蛇咬。”杨紫说道。
“杨紫姐姐，你不是说，如果箩筐里真是蛇，你就把脏水给喝了吗？？”柳大春笑着说道。
“你！！”杨紫的脸一下子就红了。
“那是开玩笑的，怎么可能下这么无语的赌注。”杨紫当即耍赖道。
“杨紫姐姐，你这样耍赖可就不好了，你以前骗我，我都把钱给你了，我还被师娘打了一顿，现在你输了，就想耍赖？那可不行的。”柳大春可长记性了。
“你！！”杨紫整个人都无语了，那东西多脏啊，想了想，便说道：“那地上也没有啊。”
“有，谁说没有啊，马上就有啊，我有，我有。”柳大春指着自己说道。。
听到这话，杨紫整个人都不好了，这时的她肠子都悔青了！！
早知道就不跟这个傻子赌了，这傻子怎么较真了？？
“你，你，你不是个傻子吗？怎么今天这么反常？？”杨紫不明白了。

"Oh, idiot, where are you sucking from, you, you!"
Liu Xueyi was extremely embarrassed, but she didn't dare to move. She thought that this fool was trying to suck out the snake's venom and save herself, so she didn't dare to move.
"Mom, please bear with me, your life is at stake." Yang Zi comforted her.
Liu Dachun held Liu Xueyi with both hands and tried to suck out the snake venom. Otherwise, it would be very troublesome for the snake venom to enter the blood circulation.
Liu Dachun had not had much contact with women. At this moment, Liu Dachun was so intimately touched, which made a certain desire in his heart arouse.
The golden-scaled anaconda in his body was even more eager to move, and there was an impulse that made Liu Dachun dark and obsessed.
Liu Xueyi asked anxiously. Fortunately, there were no villagers nearby, so it wouldn't be so embarrassing. If someone saw her, she would be embarrassed to death.
Liu Dachun sucked the snake venom for a long time before sucking it out.
"Aunt, it should be fine." Liu Dachun explained.
"Really? I won't die?" Liu Xueyi was still worried.
"No, Bamboo Leaf Green is not a highly venomous snake." Liu Dachun explained.
"Oh." Liu Xueyi quickly tidied herself up, blushing and feeling extremely embarrassed.
Only then did Liu Xueyi realize that Liu Dachun was staring at her.
"Idiot, thank you. I hope everything is fine. You idiot, you really caught a snake."
Liu Xueyi was quite surprised. This fool seemed much smarter than before.
"Well, Mom, let's go back first and observe. If there is any problem, we will go to the hospital immediately." Yang Zi said.
"Auntie, go pick some Xihuangcao and drink it right away. It can help the liver to expel the remaining snake venom. You should drink more water when you go back and excrete it through urine." Liu Dachun added.
"Idiot, I don't know Xihuangcao either?" Liu Xueyi said.
"I'll go down and collect some to send to you, or I'll ask the village doctor, Old Wu," Liu Dachun said.
"Okay, then let's go." Aunt Liu Xueyi said.
"Wait a minute, aunt, you showed me, but it's Yang Zi." Liu Dachun didn't forget Yang Zi's bet.
"What's wrong with me? I wasn't bitten by a snake." Yang Zi said.
"Sister Yang Zi, didn't you say that if there was really a snake in the basket, you would drink the dirty water?" Liu Dachun said with a smile.
"You!!" Yang Zi's face suddenly turned red.
"That was a joke. How could you make such a speechless bet?" Yang Zi immediately said.
"Sister Yang Zi, it's not good for you to cheat like this. You lied to me before, I gave you the money, and I was beaten by my wife. Now you lose, and you want to cheat? That won't work." Liu Dachun has a long memory.
"You!!" Yang Zi was speechless. That thing was so dirty. After thinking about it, he said, "There's nothing on the ground either."
"Yes, who said there isn't? It will be there soon. I have it, I have it." Liu Dachun pointed at himself and said. .
Hearing this, Yang Zi felt bad all over, and her intestines were filled with regret! !
If I had known better, I would not have bet with this fool. Why is this fool so serious? ?
"You, you, aren't you a fool? Why are you so abnormal today??" Yang Zi didn't understand.
